title: Layering
description: One of my first sound design projects, focused on understanding the three main types of layering: Cohesive, Complementary, and Contrasting. Each pad was built in Phaseplant using various oscillators and samples. Nothing flashy, but the methodology behind breaking down and layering sounds applies to any instrument, part, or track.
